scope: Symbolic component states only; none are actual source assessments or biological measurements

cases.basis: Existing invented INV-C02 B3-B5: native BETA-only value, undefined meaning/assessment and unsupported ALPHA use.
Invented component state only: incompatible supported native endpoint definitions remain unresolved under the existing source-priority process; the episode link itself is supported.
Invented component state only: definition and complete assessment evidence are supported, but the proposed episode link is unknown.
Invented component state only: definition and assessment evidence are supported, but the proposed episode use is conflicting.
Invented component state only: neither endpoint domain nor the proposed episode link is addressed.
Invented component state only: all three component states are supported. This still establishes no actual source authority or approval.
Invented component state only: a known definition cannot replace absent individual assessment, timing/window or evaluability evidence.
Invented component state only: an unresolved definition does not hide a supported contradiction in assessment evidence.
